author: hand_authored_by_PI
request_text: Produce the weekly patch compliance dashboard for the IT Operations Director. Required content: overall compliance percentage across our managed Windows fleet, with a minimum acceptable level of 95%; list of all production servers below 90% compliance; total count of security patches overdue by more than 14 days. Source data: WSUS only. Deliver as an HTML dashboard suitable for embedding in our internal SharePoint portal, due Monday at 0900 hours. Do not include unmanaged endpoints or BYOD devices. Audience: internal IT operations team.

expected_anchor.mission_intent: Provide IT Operations Director with weekly Windows patch compliance status

minimum.threshold: overall percentage, sub-90% server list, 14-day overdue count

notes_for_lead_analyst: Calibration baseline for HTML deliverable format.
